description: Fuentes de agua potable is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Málaga. List of drinking water sources in Malaga. Also available in Geoportal: Drinking water sources. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Málaga. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking water sources" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Málaga. Its keywords include ambiente, fuentes. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV, KML%2BXML, JSON, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution–ShareAlike 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
